module: Career tutorial step 4 ("timeTrial"): an intro popup launches the time trial mission west_coast_usa/timeTrial/tutorialSimple, with ground guidance (core_groundMarkers) built from the course's next pathnodes. At the end, a popup offers an optional challenge (tutorialAdvanced) or moving on; the step advances at the end of the advanced mission or if the player chooses something else. Phases: waitIntro, simpleMission, waitChoicePopup, waitPostSimplePopupClose, waitChoiceSelection, advancedMission. Activates the timeTrialBounds bounds zone.
notes: If the player stays out of bounds too long (onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsTimedOut), the current mission is restarted (core_recoveryPrompt.buttonPressed("restartMission")) with a message.
At the end of the step, the tutorial vehicle is deactivated (setActive(0)); it is reactivated at the start of the step.
At the end of the advanced mission, the code writes career_modules_tutorial.playedAdvancedTimeTrial = true; this field is not declared in tutorial.lua (dynamically added field).
If the advanced mission is not found, an error is logged and the step advances anyway.
All tracking hooks ignore events if the current step is not 04timeTrial.

setup.desc: Called on activation: activates the timeTrialBounds zone, resets the states, finds the simpleTimeTrialFinish spot, puts the player back in the tutorial vehicle and opens the v2/simpleTimeTrial popup.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Popup close hook. v2/simpleTimeTrial: starts the simple mission and, after 0.5 s, switches the track prefabs (tutorialTrackOpen). v2/timeTrialAssessmentComplete: opens the optional challenge choice popup.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: during the simple mission, updates the guidance path toward the next pathnodes (or toward the finish).

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook emitted by the mission manager. On "started" of the simple mission, remembers the race; on "stopped", moves to the assessment popup (simple mission) or advances the step (advanced mission).

onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsTimedOut.desc: Hook emitted when the player has stayed out of the zone too long: displays a warning and restarts the current mission.

onRaceStarted.desc: Race start hook: if it is the simple tutorial race, remembers it and draws the guidance.

onRacePathnodeReached.desc: Hook emitted at each pathnode reached: updates the guidance for the simple tutorial race.

onScreenFadeState.desc: Screen fade hook: when the state is 3 during waitChoicePopup, restores the "career" game state and opens the assessment or choice popup.

onCareerTutorialAdvancedOrDragSelection.desc: Called from OptionalChallengeSelect.vue when the player chooses: "advancedTimeTrial" starts the advanced mission, any other choice deactivates the vehicle and moves to the next step.

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

cleanup.desc: Called at the end of the step: removes the zone reset, clears the guidance and stops the tutorial mission if it is in the foreground.

onDebugMenu.desc: "Skip Step 4" button: stops the mission, deactivates the vehicle and advances.
